newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Burkina Faso gets $22.9 mln aid for schools.
newsitem.headline: Burkina Faso gets $22.9 mln aid for schools.

text.p: The African Development Fund has approved a loan of $22.9 million for Burkina Faso to improve various aspects of its education system, the African Development Bank (AfDB) said on Wednesday.
Some of the money will go into basic schooling, with the aim of pushing the number of children in education up to 50 percent in 2001 from 35 percent now.
Funds will also be earmarked for educating women, for training young agricultural workers, and for professional, scientific and technical education.

"The strategy of the AfDB group in Burkina Faso is to lift the main barriers to economic and social development, giving priority amongst other things to the development of human resources and the fight against poverty," the AfDB said.
